title: Xanthe and the Verdict
author: Zephyrine Montrose
blurb: Emrys Voss, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
